# Keycloak

## Single sign-on (OpenID Connect)

In the portal, choose **Keycloak** under Enterprise SSO and **Start with Keycloak**. Then, in Keycloak:

1. In the Keycloak admin console, select your realm — not master — then Clients → Create client.
2. Leave Client type as OpenID Connect and enter a Client ID.
3. Turn Client authentication on and keep Standard flow enabled — a public client has no secret to give us.
4. Add the redirect URI below to Valid Redirect URIs. Avoid wildcards.
5. Copy the client secret from the Credentials tab; the issuer is https://&lt;host&gt;/realms/&lt;realm&gt;.

### The values the portal shows

| Keycloak field | Value |
|---|---|
| Valid Redirect URIs | The portal's redirect URI (`https://…/sso/oidc/…/callback`) |
| Client authentication (Capability config) | `On` |
| Scopes | `openid email profile` |

### What to bring back

Enter **https://&lt;host&gt;/realms/&lt;realm&gt;, Client ID, Client Secret (Credentials tab)** in the portal.

Keycloak's own guide: <https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_admin/index.html#_oidc_clients>.

Then verify your domain and turn single sign-on on in the portal: [Enterprise SSO](../sso.md).
